# Parley v0.1.33

A pane that is selected and a pane that wants your attention no longer look the
same.

## Selected and "has a result" are now distinguishable

A pane holding a returned result drew a border in the accent colour, and so did
the selected pane. A selected pane with a result was indistinguishable from a
selected pane without one, and the two states were competing for the same
border.

Each meaning now has its own part of the border:

- The **outer ring is selection**, and only selection. It is drawn the same way
  whether or not the pane also wants attention. Previously selection shrank to a
  thin inner line as soon as anything else appeared, so a pane looked less
  selected exactly when there was more to see.
- **Attention is a separate inner ring**, in its own colour: orange for a
  permission request, green for a returned result waiting to be read, red for an
  interrupted handoff.

Position alone now separates the two, before colour is considered, so the
distinction survives a colour-blind reader and a changed accent colour. Green
previously meant connection health only; it now also means a returned result
waiting. Both say nothing is wrong, and they never appear on the same surface.

## Documentation

The engineering guide carried two statements that stopped being true in
v0.1.30: that certain checks cannot run inside an agent pane, and that tests
needing an unrestricted process still require a human Shell pane. Host panes
have had no outer Parley sandbox since v0.1.30 and the full suite runs in one.
Left as written they invited dismissing a real failure as an expected sandbox
limit.

There is also a new guide for building container images. Container panes require
an image meeting a precise contract, and until now that contract existed only
inside Parley's image probe: anyone building an image had to work it out from a
refusal. `docs/container-images.md` states the required utility paths, the
run-time conditions an image must tolerate, worked Dockerfiles for Debian and
Alpine bases, and a command to check any image against the same probe Parley
uses. The base-image results in it were measured, not assumed.

## Compatibility

Agent protocol is unchanged at 32. Panes do not need a restart for the protocol,
but a pane started on an earlier build keeps that build's behaviour until it is
restarted.

Validated: 331 native checks, 41 Node tests, public scan and build. The border
change has a regression check that was confirmed to fail when the original
defect is reintroduced, when attention weakens the selection ring, and when two
attention reasons share a colour.

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
